description: This file contains an interrupt service routine (ISR) written in assembly language for handling the MCI (Memory Card Interface) on an AT91 series microcontroller, including context saving/restoring and CPU mode switching.

methods.name: AT91F_ASM_MCI_Handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler called by the Advanced Interrupt Controller (AIC) to manage MCI interrupts, saving and restoring context, switching CPU modes, and signaling end of interrupt.
